en.answer: Even if <<11768>> destroys a monster that you own but was on your opponent's side of the field, its effect can be activated.
en.question: If <<11768>> destroys a monster by battle that I own but was moved to my opponent's side of the field by the effect of <<5162>>, can the effect of <<11768>> which targets and destroys an opponent's monster be activated?
en.title: If <<11768>> destroys a monster by battle that I own but was moved to my opponent's side of the field by the effect of <<5162>>, can the effect of <<11768>> which targets and destroys an opponent's monster be activated?

ja.answer: 「<<11768>>」が戦闘で破壊したモンスターが相手フィールドから自分の墓地へ送られる場合でも、『このカードが戦闘でモンスターを破壊し墓地へ送った』事になりますので、「<<11768>>」の効果を発動する事ができます。
